name: who-was-there

card.name: Buffy Summers
card.description: The Slayer. Lives at the Winters house in the hills above Sunnydale.

about: Knowledge reaches only the people a reply did: a line said at lunch, filed for the Scoobies when none of them was there, teaches none of them; the people at the table and a text to the group still count.
ledger: cast: the Scoobies (Willow, Xander, Anya, Tara)@off
reply: Walter set down his taco. "You two are Tom Paris and B'elanna Torres." Spike admitted he only watches Passions, and Buffy ruled that film Fridays were now mandatory.
